data.locator: PDF physical page 2 (PDF page index 1), H0523 table “Time Between Receiving a Prior Authorization Request and Determination”; page 2 footer identifies page 2.
data.source_setting: Aetna Medicare Advantage contract H0523; medical items/services excluding drugs
data.source_n: Request counts not supplied in selected contract tables
data.source_evidence_basis: Direct PDF table transcription: standard request mean 3.06 days and median 0 days; expedited request mean 0.54 days and median 0 days. The reported endpoint is elapsed time from receiving request to determination.
data.limitations: Reported zero-day median does not prove instantaneous decisions; rounding resolution is unspecified. Not active reviewer labor time or a distribution. 2025 reporting predates 2026 standard deadline.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Separate PA queue elapsed time from reviewer effort; require plan-specific distributions before quantitative adoption.
